origin: self-review round 3, item M1: the R2C repair rule reshared from states with fewer than t ready custodians, which threshold sharing cannot do
label: EXACT_UNDER_DECLARED_SYNTHETIC_MODEL
repair_rule: a rejected audit at time a with no pending repair schedules a resharing at a + D_r; it succeeds, making every custodian individually up, only if at least t custodians are ready at a + D_r; otherwise nothing happens until the next audit; domain states unchanged; D_r <= T
metrics: failure_with_repair: long-run Pr[dispute fails], u uniform on [0,T)
undetected_with_repair: long-run Pr[dispute fails and latest audit accepted]
alarms_per_day: rejected audits per day (resharings per day counts only successful resharings)

numerics.stationary: power iteration of the embedded audit-epoch chain, L1 tolerance 1e-13

design.rule: largest T with failure_with_repair <= target, by bisection on log T over [max(0.25, D_r), 720] h; report audits and repairs per day at that T; no combined cost

simulation_check.label: SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_CHECK
simulation_check.criterion: exact value inside the 99% Wilson interval; zero-event quantities reported as vacuous; 99% batch-means interval (100 batches) as a diagnostic

supersedes: R2C repair results (r2c-design-freeze.json); R2C withholding results stand
